profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable backend systems, cloud-native applications, and DevOps workflows in enterprise environments. I specialize in designing microservices, developing data pipelines, and optimizing cloud infrastructure to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
At Nike, I design and maintain 50+ data pipelines that integrate retail POS systems with cloud services, ensuring high data quality and low-latency processing. I also lead DevOps initiatives including CI/CD pipeline development, incident response, monitoring, and system automation to improve operational reliability and reduce time-to-resolution.
I have strong experience with AWS (EC2, Lambda), Java (Spring Boot), microservices architecture, and observability tools like Splunk and Grafana. I’ve led large-scale platform modernization efforts including security compliance upgrades across 50+ services and migration from EC2 to serverless architectures to improve scalability and reduce costs.
Previously at General Motors, I developed enterprise Java applications supporting global operations and led project management initiatives that reduced backlog by 80% and improved delivery efficiency by 40%.
I thrive at the intersection of backend engineering and DevOps, with a focus on building resilient, scalable systems and continuously improving operational processes.
Open to opportunities in Software Engineering, DevOps, and Platform Engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented 50+ scalable data pipelines integrating retail POS systems with cloud-based services, improving data reliability and reducing latency  
• Built and maintained microservices using Java, TypeScript, and Python  
• Developed ETL processes to ensure data consistency and integrity across platforms  
• Leveraged AWS (EC2, Lambda) to optimize scalability and cost efficiency  

• Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins  
• Led incident response, triage, and root cause analysis using ServiceNow and PagerDuty  
• Developed automation scripts to streamline operational workflows  

• Implemented monitoring using Splunk and Grafana to proactively detect system issues  
• Led compliance upgrades across 50+ services (Java 21, Gradle 8+, Micronaut 4)  
• Drove AWS cost optimization initiatives including EC2 → Lambda migration and service deprecation
